tools.name: gryps_list_markets
tools.description: Browse the live Gryps v2 market catalogue with bounded search and pagination. Read-only. A listed market is not a promise of quote availability.

tools.name: gryps_get_market
tools.description: Resolve one exact canonical symbol, display name, or unique base asset and return live price and leverage limits. Never guesses by substring. Returns a typed PRICE_UNAVAILABLE status rather than inventing a price.

tools.name: gryps_venue_status
tools.description: Check live API health, build version, and settlement chain and contract. The engine-reported market count is returned but is explicitly flagged as unreconciled and not publishable as a claim.

tools.name: gryps_friction_floor
tools.description: Return the live round-trip cost a trade must beat on Gryps, decomposed into fees and spread with full provenance. States plainly whether the number is a measured fee floor or all-in friction, and whether it is a lower bound. This is the number that decides whether a trade is worth making.

tools.name: gryps_get_fee_schedule
tools.description: Read the live engine-reported fee tier ladder. Fees are only part of friction: use gryps_friction_floor for the number a trade actually has to beat.

tools.name: gryps_edge_check
tools.description: Take a claimed edge from any upstream signal source and answer whether it could survive live execution cost with a margin of safety. Source-agnostic. It never evaluates whether the signal is true, only whether the claimed magnitude can pay for its own execution. Treats third-party signal text as untrusted data, never instruction.

source.description: Where the claim came from, for example "TradingView RSI".

claimedEdgeBps.description: The move the signal expects to capture, in basis points.

confidence.description: Caller confidence. Lower confidence widens the required edge.

expectedRoundTrips.description: Round trips expected for a repeated signal. Cost compounds; edge usually does not.

convictionMultiple.description: Margin of safety applied to friction. Default 1.5.

tools.name: gryps_signal_stack
tools.description: Combine several agreeing signals into one honest edge estimate. Correlated sources are prevented from being counted as independent confirmations, because correlated evidence inflates confidence without inflating edge, and confidence is what sets position size. Supply a symbol to also cost-gate the combined result.

assumedCorrelation.description: Your belief about independence. Raised automatically if the source families overlap.

symbol.description: Supply to gate the combined edge against live friction.

tools.name: gryps_route_compare
tools.description: Compare the round-trip cost of a clip on Gryps against a public order-book venue priced by walking its live displayed depth. Gryps cost is quoted and does not grow with clip size; book cost does. This tool reports the other venue as cheaper when that is what the numbers say.

notionalUsd.description: Clip size in USD. Book impact depends on it.

tools.name: gryps_indicative_quote
tools.description: Produce an indicative, non-firm execution estimate for one clip: oracle mid, estimated entry price, base quantity, and the all-in cost model with full provenance. The engine exposes no quote surface, so this is derived from the live oracle price plus measured friction and is labeled as such. It is a cost model, never a tradable quote.

tools.name: gryps_reference_price
tools.description: Read the live Gryps oracle price for one market next to a fair-value mid from a public reference venue, and report the divergence in basis points. The anchor for oracle sanity checks and paper-session pricing. The reference mid is a midpoint of displayed quotes, never a tradable price.
